spans.s: इतर a. (f. रा, n. रत्) 1. Another; 2. different from, other than, इतरतापशतानि … वितर Ud. (often used with abl. like अन्य q.v.); 3. low, ordinary, इतर इव परिभूय ज्ञानं मन्मथेन जडीकृतः Kad.; 4. the remaining one of the two (in this sense it is often used as the last member of a compound, e.g. दक्षिणेतर) e.g. विजयायेतराय वै. (इतरतः and इतरत्र are used in the same senses as अन्यतः and अन्यत्र qq.vv.)

इतर-इतर˚योग m. 1. mutual connection; 2. a species of Dvandva compound, (op. to समाहार q.v.).
इतरेद्युस् ind. On another day, the other day.
इतस् ind. 1. From here, hence; 2. from this time; 3. from this world; 4. from this person, इतः स दैत्यः प्राफ्तश्रीर्नेत एवार्हति क्षयम् K.S.ii.55; 5. here, इतो निषीदेति विसृष्टभुमिः K.S.iii.2.
